headline: Exclusive-Intel providing chip technology to startup led by co-investor of Tan in rare deal
summary: Intel has provided access to some of its processor technology to a new startup, according to a source and ‌documents reviewed by Reuters, in a rare move for the U.S. chipmaker.  Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan ‌and the startup's boss are longtime co-investors.  The startup, RosaicLabs Inc., filed its first Delaware incorporation documents in May, according to a certificate of ​incorporation from the state.
